description: The STREAM project deposits the planned schedule and setpoints for a Spanish community battery. Its Zenodo page names Time, Active power and Setpoints in one public CSV of about 38 KB, licensed CC BY 4.0. The provider attributes the schedule to sFLEX optimisation of community energy use and costs subject to local flexibility-market participation. A modeller could compare planned and actual battery behaviour, or use the schedule as a control input to a local-grid simulation. This is a particular pilot’s optimisation output, not a transferable controller with source code or an observed battery response. The page does not define setpoint encoding, power units, battery capacity, scheduling horizon or market-rule constraints. Those conditions are needed before claiming the schedule is physically feasible in another system. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this control-series release. The CSV was not downloaded or run against the battery SOC deposit.
name: STREAM ES-UC.04.01 Community battery setpoint - Spanish pilot site
